title: bk interactive question set
description: A pre-coded, modifiable question set for putting engineer-input blocks interactively. Modelled on the harness's built-in interactive prompt so a validated set renders straight into it, with the five things the built-in shape does not carry: a stable id, a declared kind, a validated cost per option, a recorded decision, and an escalation path. Copy TEMPLATE-question-set.json, edit it, run `bkquestion validate`.

schema_version.description: Bumped only on a breaking change. A reader that does not recognise the value must refuse rather than parse optimistically.

set_id.description: Stable identity for the whole set, e.g. Q-020-20260824T0810Z. Cite this in a commit, a spec, or a coop letter. Without it an answer is recoverable only from a transcript, which is where today's rulings live and why this field exists.

context.description: Optional one-paragraph situation shared by every question in the set. Per-question background still belongs IN the question.

questions.description: At most four. The built-in prompt takes four; a fifth question means the set should be split, not squeezed.

id.description: Stable per-question id, e.g. Q-020-03. This is what a later document cites.

kind.description: Why the kind is declared: a risk-acceptance SHOULD expire and a ruling should NOT. Collapsing them is how a temporary acceptance becomes permanent policy without anyone deciding that it should.

expires_after_days.description: Required for kind 'risk-acceptance', forbidden for kind 'ruling'. Enforced by the validator, not by convention.

header.description: The chip label. 12 characters is the built-in prompt's limit, checked here so the failure is at authoring time rather than at ask time.

question.description: The complete question, carrying its own BACKGROUND: what was found, where, and why it needs a human. A question needing three paragraphs of preamble to be answerable is not yet a question. Ends with '?'.

blocks.description: What is blocked until this is answered. An unanswered question with nothing named here is not blocking, and should not be asked interactively.

escalate_after_hours.description: How long this may sit unanswered before it is escalated. Null means never escalate — legitimate for a non-blocking clarification, and a smell on anything else.

options.description: Two to four. The built-in prompt adds a free-text 'Other' automatically, so do not author one.

label.description: 1-5 words. Do NOT append '(Recommended)' by hand — set `recommended: true` and the renderer adds it, so exactly one option can carry it.

recommended.description: At most one per question. The renderer moves it first, because an engineer accepting a recommendation should need one keystroke.

cost.description: What choosing this GIVES UP. Mandatory and validated, not conventional: an option with no stated downside is advocacy wearing the costume of a choice, and a set of those is a decision already made.
